let b: number;
switch (1 + 0) { case 1: b = 1; break; }
console.log(b);
function uncertain(which: 'a' | 'b') {
  let result: number;
  switch ('a') { case which: result = 1; break; }
  return result;
}
function hasDefault() {
  let result: number;
  switch (1) { case 1: result = 1; break; default: break; }
  return result;
}
function nonmatchingCase() {
  let result: number;
  switch (1) { case 1: result = 1; break; case 2: break; }
  return result;
}
function nonmatchingBefore() {
  let result: number;
  switch (1) { case 2: break; case 1: result = 1; }
  return result;
}
function falseBranch(flag: boolean) {
  let result: number;
  switch (false) { case flag: result = 1; }
  return result;
}
function noMatch() {
  let result: number;
  switch (1) { case 2: result = 1; break; }
  return result;
}
